objective.name: received_item
objective.description: Defines the durable reference to an incoming result that has satisfied or contributed to an expected item in a wait group.

functional._expected_ref_note: Required. Reference to the expected item that this received result resolves or contributes to.
functional._message_id_note: Required. Identifier of the durable message carrying the received result in the continuity history.
functional._outcome_note: Required. Operational outcome associated with the received result.
